_about: Lamar's Pawn (10508 FL-20, Bristol): buys and sells guns, armor and goods. A gun's value is its base value plus a share for each part that isn't the factory one; Lamar pays 'pays' of that and sells at 'sells' of it. Whatever players sell him goes in his case for anyone to buy; he restocks from 'stockStart' while the case is low. No fighting inside the shop.
name: Lamar's Pawn
